Batch 42’s malformed manifest also blocked the in-repository readiness recorder; I generated the A3 and B2 records with that recorder against a temporary snapshot excluding only batch 42, and verified both records’ hashes closed against batch 28 and 29 inputs. No foreign batch files were changed. These authoring records are not independent approval.
